news.headline: Harrow Stock Hits 52-Week Low at $28.51
news.summary: Harrow shares touched a 52-week low of $28.51, down about 38% year to date, as the Q2 earnings miss (adjusted loss of $0.46 vs. about $0.11 expected) weighs on sentiment. BTIG reiterated its Buy rating with a $63 target on October 7.

news.headline: Harrow has lost 32% in 3 months: why BTIG sees 106% upside from here
news.summary: BTIG reaffirmed its Buy rating with a $63 price target after the stock fell about 32% in three months. First-half revenue of $115M trails the plan, so Harrow needs $235-250M in 2H to hit its 2026 guidance.

news.headline: Harrow Closes Acquisition of TYRVAYA®
news.summary: Harrow closed its purchase of TYRVAYA (varenicline nasal spray for dry eye) from Viatris outside Japan for $30M cash plus up to $70M in sales milestones. The product is expected to contribute over $30M of revenue in 2027.

news.headline: Harrow Ophthalmic Portfolio Highlighted in 15 Scientific Presentations at AAOpt and AAO
news.summary: Harrow will present 15 abstracts (13 at AAOpt, Sept 30-Oct 3; 2 at AAO, Oct 9-12) covering VEVYE, VERKAZIA, FLAREX and BYQLOVI, including Phase 3 and 52-week long-term safety data.

news.headline: Harrow announces IHEEZO data on patient-reported discomfort after intravitreal injections
news.summary: Harrow highlighted clinical evidence for IHEEZO and BYOOVIZ at the ASRS 2026 annual meeting, including data on patient-reported discomfort around intravitreal injections.

news.headline: Harrow Q2 2026 earnings call: VEVYE record revenue, G-MELT pre-NDA planned for early Q4
news.summary: Management reiterated 2026 guidance of $350-365M revenue and $80-100M adjusted EBITDA, implying a strong second half. A pre-NDA meeting for G-MELT is planned for early Q4 2026 with NDA submission targeted for 1H 2027.

catalysts.label: G-MELT (MELT-300) pre-NDA meeting with FDA
catalysts.detail: Pre-NDA meeting guided for early Q4 2026 on the Q2 call; no outcome disclosed yet. NDA submission targeted for 1H 2027.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly results, likely around November 9-10 (last year's Q3 was reported November 10; Harrow usually announces the date about two weeks ahead). Full-year guidance of $350-365M revenue implies roughly $235-250M in 2H, so Q3 needs record revenue and positive EBITDA; first quarter with TYRVAYA contribution.

catalysts.label: Launch of late-stage assets (G-MELT, YOCHIL)
catalysts.detail: Harrow intends to launch G-MELT and YOCHIL (formerly MELT-210) beginning in 2028.

pulse: Harrow trades near $29-30 after hitting a 52-week low of $28.51 on October 9, about 38% down year to date following the Q2 earnings miss, although BTIG ($63, Buy) and most analysts stay bullish. The TYRVAYA acquisition closed October 5 and adds a dry-eye product expected to bring more than $30M of revenue in 2027. Q3 results in early-to-mid November must show a strong 2H ramp to keep the $350-365M revenue guidance credible; a G-MELT pre-NDA update is also pending.
